recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-20416 unless a work group separately revisits FHIR-25397 or FHIR-23029.
issue_request: FHIR-20416 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for Condition.encounter's fragmented short description and approved the replacement short text 'The Encounter during which this {title} was created' for Condition plus Procedure, AdverseEvent, CarePlan, CareTeam, ClinicalImpression, Communication, and CommunicationRequest.
initial_application: The issue was applied by e8c58236b5b356e87255d76c7d5d319fe8e4cb68 on 2019-03-02, which changed the then-authoritative spreadsheets for all named resources. The current XML StructureDefinition sources preserve that wording for Condition, Procedure, CarePlan, ClinicalImpression, Communication, and CommunicationRequest.
additional_context: FHIR-25397 later changed AdverseEvent.encounter to 'The Encounter associated with the start of the AdverseEvent', and FHIR-23029 later removed CareTeam.encounter to avoid circular references because Encounter references CareTeam. Both later issues are Published and already represented on the combined branch, so they were treated as context rather than additional decisions.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already satisfies FHIR-20416 for Condition.encounter and the remaining still-existing peer elements, while reintroducing the original AdverseEvent or CareTeam wording would conflict with later Published Patient Care decisions.
